name: e2e-slow
description: Profile for the brake leg of the end-to-end suite: a single-threaded origin on loopback and an SLO tight enough that a modest rate crosses it. The point is to prove the brake ABORTS a run — the fast leg (profile.json) proves the opposite case.
_slo_comment: Tight on purpose. guillotine_ms is above max_p95_ms as it must be, but both are low enough that a single-threaded origin at this rate crosses them within one step.
